## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the failure modes it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q src tests`
- [ ] Added or updated tests
- [ ] Added or updated documentation
- [ ] Confirmed no secrets, audio files, logs, or local configs are included

## Risks and compatibility

Describe provider contract changes, platform limitations, new dependencies, or migration notes.

## Hardware/provider details

For provider or device changes, include sanitized event evidence and the tested environment. Never include real credentials or personal audio.
